In this video, we look into one of the strangest and most unsettling research projects on AI. What happens when you trap 1,000 AI agents in a Minecraft server? The scientists at Altera wanted to find out. What followed was indicative of an absurd sci-fi concept brought to the real world. The question is, what else will this bring to the real world?
